## About the conference

The **Democracy and Political Violence APSA Pre-Conference** brings together
researchers studying political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes across
comparative and national contexts. The day features three main panels, a poster
session, and structured opportunities to connect researchers.

Organized by Sam, Gal, and Jack. See [About](about.qmd).
